description: Wouwermanstraat 6-24 (1910-1911): 6.0-6.6 m brick fronts (dark brown, yellow or red) of four tall storeys under a white timber cornice at 15.3 m over a brick frieze; three axes of white windows with segmental heads on stone springers; a white glazed timber oriel on a heavy bracketed console on the centre axis of storey 2; an iron-railed balcony on the centre axis of storey 1; a round-arched house-door portal on an end axis; over the centre axis either a brick tower dormer with one tall light (6-16) or a white pediment dormer (18-24)

match.note: Wouwermanstraat 14 and 22 on the 2024-11-06 strip (40 px/m, 1 m grid): white cornice top 15.2-15.3 m; 3DBAG eaves 14.0-14.4 m sit a metre under the photo's cornice, and 3DBAG counts five storeys in four tall ones, so the cornice is the type's front line (frontEavesM). BAG 1910-1911 on the exemplars, widths 6.0-6.6 m

tower-dormer.note: Wouwermanstraat 6-16: a brick tower dormer 1.85 m wide flush with the front over the centre axis, from the frieze at 14.4 m to a flat coping at 18.2 m, one tall white light 15.5-17.3 m

pediment-dormer.note: Wouwermanstraat 18-24 (and 26-34): one white timber dormer about 1.7 m wide over the centre axis, its body 15.4-16.8 m to a pediment at 17.7 m

door-left.note: Wouwermanstraat 14, 10: the house door under a round-arched portal 1.5 m wide to 4.0 m on the left axis

door-right.note: Wouwermanstraat 12, 6: mirrored, the portal on the right axis

rhythm.identicalBays: every upper storey: three windows of one width (1.15-1.2 m) under segmental heads; the centre window of storey 2 is the oriel
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric on the oriel axis; the door portal on the left or right axis
rhythm.groundFloor: residential: a round-arched house-door portal and two windows
rhythm.roofline: white timber cornice at 15.3 m over a 0.6 m brick frieze; a brick tower dormer or a white pediment dormer on the centre axis

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11-06 at 40 px/m, 1 m grid (Wouwermanstraat 14, 6.0 m): ground windows 1.0-3.85 m, the door portal 0.4-1.9 m across to 4.0 m; balcony slab 4.3 m, storey 1 windows 4.6-7.3 m; oriel console 7.0-8.2 m, oriel 8.2-11.3 m, 2.2 m across; storey 2 side windows 8.0-10.7 m; storey 3 11.05-13.95 m; segmental heads on light springer blocks at every storey; frieze 14.4-15.0 m, white cornice 15.0-15.3 m; tower dormer 2.2-4.0 m across to 18.2 m, light 15.5-17.3 m; side windows 1.2 m wide

strip.jpg 2024-11-06 at 40 px/m (Wouwermanstraat 22, yellow brick): the same storey lines within 0.1 m, oriel 8.3-11.4 m under a hipped hood, a zigzag moulded frieze 14.4-14.9 m, cornice to 15.3 m, white pediment dormer 15.4-17.7 m
strip.jpg 2024-11-06 pands 20-6: the same axes, oriel, console, balcony and cornice; tower dormers on 16-6, pediment dormers on 20-18

schemaLimits: the moulded zigzag frieze under the cornice is drawn as plain wall (entablature frieze)
the oriel's heavy carved stone console is the kit's oriel console slab
the oriel's angled hood and its glazing bars are the kit's hipped erker cap and two front lights
the top storey's centre window over the oriel is drawn full height; the photo's is shortened by the oriel hood
notes: Palette: placed pands take their own measured wall (auto-place measuredPalette); one brick per row from tree-free columns at install.
